name: cloud.s3
doc:
cloud.s3: an S3 client written in Zell over net.http (docs/
STDLIB.md level 3b), compatible with AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2 and
Google Cloud Storage's XML API. Two files share the namespace:

  s3.zl       AWS Signature V4 (canonical request, string to sign,
              signing key; header and presigned query signing),
              credentials (env, ~/.aws/credentials, IMDSv2), Config,
              Client: objects, buckets, listing, copy, errors, retries
  s3_multi.zl multipart uploads (parallel parts), presigned URLs,
              iteration over listings

Payloads are hashed (x-amz-content-sha256) because request bodies are
in memory; Config.UnsignedPayload sends UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD instead (only
over https). Errors from the service are s3.Error values; NoSuchKey,
NoSuchBucket, AccessDenied and PreconditionFailed also match the
sentinels ErrNoSuchKey... with errors.Is.

items.summary: Credentials from a shared credentials file (path "": AWS_SHARED_ CREDENTIALS_FILE or ~/.aws/credentials; profile "": AWS_PROFILE or "default").

items.name: NewClient
items.doc:
A client for cfg. Without keys in cfg the environment and
~/.aws/credentials are tried (NewClientAuto also tries IMDS).
items.summary: A client for cfg.

items.name: NewClientAuto
items.doc: NewClient with the full credential chain, including IMDSv2.
items.summary: NewClient with the full credential chain, including IMDSv2.

items.name: SignV4
items.signature: func SignV4(method string, path string, query string, headers map[string]string, payloadHash string, accessKey string, secretKey string, region string, service string, amzDate string) Signed
items.doc:
Signs a request. path is the URI-encoded path as sent, query its raw
query, headers every header to sign (any case; host included),
payloadHash the hex SHA-256 of the body or "UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD", amzDate
"YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ".
items.summary: Signs a request.

items.name: SigningKey
items.signature: func SigningKey(secret string, date string, region string, service string) []byte
items.doc: The SigV4 signing key: HMAC chain over date (YYYYMMDD), region, service.
items.summary: The SigV4 signing key: HMAC chain over date (YYYYMMDD), region, service.

items.name: URIEncode
items.signature: func URIEncode(s string, encodeSlash bool) string
items.doc:
RFC 3986 percent-encoding as SigV4 wants it: unreserved characters
(A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . ~) as they are, '/' kept unless encodeSlash.
items.summary: RFC 3986 percent-encoding as SigV4 wants it: unreserved characters (A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ .

members.name: Upload
members.signature: func Upload(bucket string, key string, r io.Reader, partSize int, concurrency int) Task<PutResult!>
members.doc:
Uploads everything r yields: one PutObject when it fits in one part,
else a multipart upload with up to concurrency parts of partSize
bytes (>= 5 MiB except the last; 0: 8 MiB) in flight; aborted on
failure.
members.summary: Uploads everything r yields: one PutObject when it fits in one part, else a multipart upload with up to concurrency parts of partSize bytes (>= 5 MiB except the last; 0: 8 MiB) in flight; aborted on failure.

items.doc:
Client configuration. Endpoint examples: "" (AWS: https://s3.<region>.
amazonaws.com), "http://localhost:9000" (MinIO, with PathStyle),
"https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com" (R2, Region "auto"),
"https://storage.googleapis.com" (GCS HMAC keys).
items.summary: Client configuration.
